title: Watercolor 685 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- 4 adult bikes- Primary Suite with Fireplace and Private Porch - Indoor and Outdoor Dining - Wonderful Porches- This property comes with 2 dedicated parking spots. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: This luxurious WaterColor home at 685 Western Lake Dr. is a 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom that sleeps 10. Guests will love the home’s multiple porches, fireplaces, and the posh interior and premium finishes found throughout. A deep porch with a hanging daybed welcomes guests to the home. Stepping inside the entry hall, guests will see double doors that open to a guest bedroom with a plush queen bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The hallway continues to a kitchen, dining, and living area that is open but does not sacrifice privacy thanks to the smart design. The kitchen has premium stainless-steel appliances, marble countertops, and an island with a built-in gas range and seating for 5. An adjacent dining area with modern art, a lotus flower chandelier, and a round dining table share wooded views with the living room. A sectional chaise sofa and cozy armchairs face a large fireplace and flat-screen TV, creating a lovely place for guests to gather. French doors open to a screened porch overlooking nature trails that cut through the woods. It’s a serene spot to enjoy a cup of morning coffee or relax after an adventurous day. Steps lead down to an outdoor dining table and gas grill. A grand stairway with a striking chandelier leads to the second floor, where guests will discover 2 guest bedrooms, a primary bedroom, and a hallway filled with bookcases and reading nooks. The first guest bedroom has a lovely queen bed, views of the front balcony, and a private bathroom with shower only. A door from the hall opens to the balcony, which enjoys views of the neighborhood. A second guest bedroom takes advantage of sloped walls with 2 built-in twin beds and 2 trundles. Its private bathroom has a shower only. The primary bedroom feels like a vacation in of itself! This spacious retreat has a king bed that faces a gas fireplace and flat-screen TV. French doors open to a private, screened balcony with cushioned chairs and views of the woods and nature trails below. The bedroom’s private bathroom has a large soaking tub and a separate shower. With its thoughtful décor and fabulous location, 685 Western Lake Dr. won’t last long. Guests can also discover WaterColor’s many parks and community pools on 4 included adult bikes. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR: -Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds with Two Twin Trundles, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.**Please be advised that there is active construction two doors down from this home.
